title: The Handmaid's Tale: The Graphic Novel
author: Margaret Atwood
current_text: In a report dated June 29, 2022, the superintendent of the Medford School District, Bret Champion, and his deputy made the decision to remove the graphic novel version from the library collection. The district said it removed it because it found numerous images of nudity, sexual assault and violence.
